Name: Custom Starter Furniture
Author: aedenthorn
Description:

The keys used must be unique but are arbitrary; each entry in the dictionary has a list of furniture to add, so the above could have all been added under a single key.

[b]NameOrIndex[/b] is either the object's name or index in [b]Data/Furniture[/b].
[b]
FarmType[/b] is the 0-based index of the farm you select in the character customization screen. Use -1 to apply to all farm types.

Set [b]Clear[/b] to [b]false[/b] if you don't want the vanilla furniture to be removed.

[b]HeldObjectType[/b] can be set to either [b]Object[/b] or [b]Furniture[/b].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
